review_findings.finding: A resolved Runtime.evaluate promise is not a Network event barrier. Cloning rows before terminal events can retain stale missing-body state.
review_findings.resolution: Settle exact expected URL occurrences including repeated requests, entry and denied probe, require every loading terminal and request-gate acknowledgement, and keep the original absolute deadline.

review_findings.finding: A late Fetch acknowledgement error could reach Browser.close's tolerated failure path.
review_findings.resolution: Share response identity/error handling with the explicit drain; require the phase and every gate to be settled before HAR, phase change and Browser.close.

review_findings.finding: Initializing missing content.size to 0 incorrectly turns unknown size into an observed empty body.
review_findings.resolution: Omit text/size for missing bodies; use empty MIME fallback; write size only after retrieving an actual body, including 0 for an observed empty body.

review_findings.finding: Retained directory descriptors alone do not bind later published text paths or the Chrome profile path after ancestor/output renames.
review_findings.resolution: Root separately implemented repeated Directory.verify_location checks and rename regressions; those changes are outside this extracted CDP unit-test receipt.
